# Cursor — Style Reference

> Unbleached drafting paper on a quiet workbench. Small weight-400 gothic and typewriter mono sit on #f7f7f4 stock, hairlines are ink at 10%, and one ember-orange link waits at the end of each feature.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Cursor speaks a warm-paper workbench language in which the typography deliberately steps aside and the product windows do the shouting. The canvas is an off-white #f7f7f4. Sections are set on #f2f1ed panels, selected rows on #ebeae5 and secondary pills on #e6e5e0, so every surface is the same warm grey moved one notch darker. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue in the chrome: ember #f54e00, rationed to "Learn about →" text links. Amber, green, red and blue appear only inside the product mockups as status. Typography is a single proprietary gothic held at weight 400 everywhere. The hero headline caps out at 26px, which is anti-convention for a page where a 64–96px H1 would be normal. Hierarchy comes from ink-versus-grey color at an identical 22px rather than from size or weight. Chrome shapes are 4px rectangles and full pills, and the page itself casts no shadows. Only the floating app windows get depth. The result reads as a well-kept engineering notebook rather than a launch-day billboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#f7f7f4` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Body background, nav bar fill, mockup window bodies and inverted button text (32 bg uses) — the warm off-white keeps the page out of clinical-white territory. |
| Linen Panel | `#f2f1ed` | `--color-linen-panel` | Feature section panels, logo tiles, footer and file tabs (55 bg uses, the most frequent fill) — it is the workhorse second layer that replaces every shadow in the chrome. |
| Stone Tile | `#ebeae5` | `--color-stone-tile` | Selected sidebar row, install-command field and active task in mockups — one notch darker marks "current" without needing a color. |
| Pebble Fill | `#e6e5e0` | `--color-pebble-fill` | Secondary pill button fill such as "Request a demo →" (10 uses) — it is the only solid non-ink button surface. Do not use it for card backgrounds. |
| Quartz Knob | `#e1e0db` | `--color-quartz-knob` | Window traffic-light dots, 20px circular controls and toggle knobs — the darkest neutral surface, sized strictly for small hardware-like details. |
| Ink | `#26251e` | `--color-ink` | All primary text, primary pill fill, borders of filled buttons and the logo (311 text uses, 39 bg uses) — a warm olive-black that harmonizes with the paper stack. |
| Graphite Caption | `#0000008c` | `--color-graphite-caption` | Feature descriptions, secondary meta text and mockup subtitles at 55% black — it carries hierarchy where other systems would drop the size. |
| Ash Hint | `#00000061` | `--color-ash-hint` | Placeholders, timestamps, "Planning next moves" status and disabled task text (18 uses) — the quietest legible text tier at 38% black. |
| Smoke Hairline | `#26251e1a` | `--color-smoke-hairline` | 1px window rings, outlined "Contact sales" pill, composer borders and shadow rings — ink at 10%, so hairlines tint warm instead of grey. |
| Ember Link | `#f54e00` | `--color-ember-link` | "Learn about agentic development →" and the other feature links (10 uses) — the single chrome accent. Do not promote it to a button fill or a heading color. |
| Amber Plan | `#c08532` | `--color-amber-plan` | Plan-mode chip text, "Continue" button inside the agent mockup, and the 15% tint chip `#c0853226` — color that exists only inside the product, never in the page chrome. |
| Forest Merge | `#34785c` | `--color-forest-merge` | "View PR" button fill and border inside the Slack mockup — a status color with one appearance. It belongs to rendered UI, not to marketing CTAs. |
| Moss Diff | `#1f8a65` | `--color-moss-diff` | "+68" and "+135" diff counters in mockups — the additive half of the diff vocabulary. Its red partner `#cf2d56` is mockup-internal, not a system token. |

## Tokens — Typography

### CursorGothic — the single voice for every heading, nav item, button and marketing sentence · `--font-cursor-gothic`

- **Substitute:** Geist at 400, Inter at 400 with +0.01em tracking at 14px, Instrument Sans at 400. CursorGothic draws true to its nominal weight with slightly open apertures. Inter at 400 reads a hair darker at 14px, so do not step it up to 500.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 14px, 16px, 22px, 26px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (buttons), 1.25, 1.3, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0.14px at 14px, 0.08px at 16px, -0.11px at 22px, -0.325px at 26px
- **OpenType features:** `"ss08"`, `"ss09"`
- **Role:** Weight 400 at every size, with 154 uses against only 2 at 500, is the signature: the brand never raises its voice typographically. Tracking runs from +0.01em at 14px to -0.0125em at 26px. This is textbook optical compensation but applied to a scale whose top is a modest 26px. The jump from 16px to 22px is the only interval larger than a Minor Third (1.375). Everything else moves in steps of 1.14–1.18, so the scale is a staircase of near-equals. The stylistic sets ss08 and ss09 swap alternate glyphs and give the face its slightly mechanical accent.

### berkeleyMono — the terminal and code voice inside CLI mockups and install commands · `--font-berkeley-mono`

- **Substitute:** JetBrains Mono at 400, Commit Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400. Berkeley Mono is a narrow, even-stroked mono that reads light at 12px. Avoid Fira Code, which draws noticeably bolder.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 700
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px
- **Line height:** 1.43, 1.5, 1.625, 1.67
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px, 0px at 13px
- **Role:** With 175 uses, this is the most frequent family on the page, which tells you the page is mostly product. It sets the Cursor CLI transcript, file paths and the `curl` install line at 12px with a generous 1.625 leading. Weight 700 appears only for emphasized list items inside the agent's reply. Pairing a typewriter mono with a quiet gothic makes the marketing copy read as an annotation to the code rather than the other way round.

### system-ui — the native app chrome rendered inside the desktop mockups · `--font-system-ui`

- **Substitute:** use the platform stack directly; Inter at 400 is the fallback where a webfont is required.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 11px, 12px, 13px, 14px, 20px
- **Line height:** 1.27, 1.33, 1.55
- **Letter spacing:** 0.05px at 11px, 0px at 12px, 0px at 13px, -0.15px at 14px
- **OpenType features:** `"case"`
- **Role:** This is the intentional honesty layer. The mockups render in the operating system's own font so they read as real software, not as illustrations. It owns the 11px uppercase weight-500 micro-labels ("IN PROGRESS 1", "READY FOR REVIEW 4") and the 13px task descriptions. Weights 600–700 exist only here, so bold type on the page always signals "this is the app". The Slack mockup's Lato is mockup-internal and not a system font.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | system-ui | 500 | 11px | 1.27 | 0.05px | `--text-small` |
| caption | berkeleyMono | 400 | 12px | 1.625 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | system-ui | 400 | 13px | 1.55 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | CursorGothic | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | 0.14px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | CursorGothic | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0.08px | `--text-body-lg` |
| heading | CursorGothic | 400 | 22px | 1.3 | -0.11px | `--text-heading` |
| display | CursorGothic | 400 | 26px | 1.25 | -0.325px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Cap the hero headline at 26px CursorGothic weight 400 with -0.325px tracking — the product window below is the real headline.
- Rank feature heading and description by color, both at 22px: #26251e for the claim, #0000008c for the support — size stays constant so the eye reads one sentence in two tones.
- Build depth in the chrome by tonal steps only: #f7f7f4 → #f2f1ed → #ebeae5 → #e6e5e0 — each step marks a layer without a shadow.
- Reserve shadows for floating app windows, using the lg value (0px 28px 70px #00000024 plus a 1px #26251e1a ring) — depth is the signal that something is software.
- Use 9999px pills for every action and 4px corners for every panel, tile and image — two shapes, no middle ground in the chrome.
- Set code, paths and terminal output in berkeleyMono 12px at 1.625 line-height — the generous leading makes transcripts readable at small size.
- Spend #f54e00 only on one text link per feature panel at 16px — the accent stays a waypoint, not a theme.

### Don't

- Don't scale the hero to a conventional 64px bold display — it breaks the thesis that the interface, not the type, carries the page.
- Don't introduce weight 600 or 700 in CursorGothic; marketing type stays at 400 with 500 used twice — bold belongs to system-ui inside the mockups, and borrowing it blurs the line between page and product.
- Don't fill a primary button with #f54e00 — the ember accent loses its rarity the moment it becomes a 42px slab.
- Don't swap the paper stack for pure #ffffff and neutral greys — it kills the warm #f7f7f4/#26251e harmony that every hairline (#26251e1a) depends on.
- Don't add drop shadows to feature panels or logo tiles at #f2f1ed — shadowing the chrome flattens the contrast that makes the floating windows read as live software.
- Don't round panels to 12–16px like a typical SaaS card — the 4px corner is what makes the panels read as paper sheets rather than app widgets.
- Never let amber #c08532 or green #34785c escape the mockups into nav, buttons or headings — status colors outside the product read as decoration and break the one-accent budget.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f7f7f4 (Paper Canvas)
- section panel: #f2f1ed (Linen Panel)
- primary text: #26251e (Ink)
- secondary text: #0000008c (Graphite Caption)
- hairline: #26251e1a (Smoke Hairline)
- accent link: #f54e00 (Ember Link)
- primary action: #26251e (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars render in Ink #26251e and the paper neutrals. Only diff-style data may use Moss Diff #1f8a65 as solid text or as a 15% tint, and Ember Link #f54e00 is not used as a data fill.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #26251e, text color #f7f7f4, a 1px solid #26251e border, border-radius 9999px, padding 12px 22px, and a total height of 42px. Use CursorGothic (fallback Geist at 400) 16px weight 400 with line-height 1.0 and no letter-spacing, followed by a ⤓ glyph separated by a 6px gap. No box-shadow. On hover, shift the background to #26251e at 90% via opacity 0.9 only. Pair it 8px to the right with a secondary pill identical in size, using background #e6e5e0 and text #26251e with a trailing →.

2. Build a hero section on a #f7f7f4 page inside a 1300px centered container. Start with a left-aligned h1 in CursorGothic 26px weight 400, line-height 1.25, letter-spacing -0.325px, color #26251e, broken over two lines and capped at 580px wide. Place two 42px pills 22px below it: primary ink and secondary pebble as described above. Leave 48px of space, then add a 1300×780 stage with border-radius 4px whose background is a painted landscape image set to object-fit cover. Over it, float a desktop window (background #f7f7f4, radius 10px, shadow `0px 28px 70px 0px #00000024, 0px 14px 32px 0px #0000001a, 0px 0px 0px 1px #26251e1a`, 30px title bar with three 8px #e1e0db dots). Add a second CLI window offset right that overflows the stage bottom, using shadow `0px 22px 70px 4px #0000004d, 0px 0px 0px 0.5px #00000026` and berkeleyMono 12px text at line-height 1.625.

3. Build a feature panel: a 1300px block with background #f2f1ed, border-radius 4px, no border or shadow, laid out as two columns at 1:2. The text column has 22px inset and is vertically centered. It holds a heading in CursorGothic 22px weight 400, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing -0.11px, color #26251e, then immediately a description at the same 22px and line-height in #0000008c, then 16px of space and a link in CursorGothic 16px weight 400 color #f54e00 ending with →. The mockup column holds a 4px-radius painted stage with 12px inset from the panel edge and a floating app window inside it with radius 10px. Alternate the column order on the next panel and separate panels by 90px.

4. Build a navigation bar: position fixed, top 0, height 52px, full width, background #f7f7f4, no border or shadow, with content in a 1300px container. Place the Cursor wordmark left in #26251e at 96px wide. Center five links (Models, Product, Enterprise, Pricing, Resources) in CursorGothic 14px weight 400, line-height 1.5, color #26251e, padding 6px 16px, radius 0px. On the right, add a "Sign in" text link with 4px padding, then an outlined pill (transparent fill, 1px #26251e1a border, text #26251e) and an ink pill (#26251e fill, #f7f7f4 text). Both pills are 14px weight 400, padding 6px 10px, radius 9999px, 28px tall, with an 8px gap between them.

### Pill Button — Pebble (Secondary)

**Role:** Demo request beside the primary

A tonal sibling, not an outline. Its spec is background #e6e5e0, text #26251e, a 1px border in the fill color, 9999px radius, 12px 22px padding, 42px height, CursorGothic 16px weight 400 and a trailing → arrow. It has no shadow. Conventional secondaries are outlined. Cursor instead drops one surface step, which keeps the pair reading as two values of the same paper rather than as filled-versus-empty.

### Compact Nav Pill — Ink and Outline

**Role:** Header-scale Download and Contact sales

The 28px miniature. Its spec is CursorGothic 14px weight 400 at 1.0 line-height with 6px 10px padding and a 9999px radius. The ink variant uses background #26251e and text #f7f7f4. The outline variant uses a transparent fill, text #26251e and a 1px #26251e1a hairline. It has no shadow. This is the same capsule shrunk for the bar, and the outline variant is the only place an outlined button exists at all.

### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Fixed header, logo and links

A flat paper strip. It is position fixed and 52px tall, with background #f7f7f4, no border and no shadow, and its content is bounded by the 1300px container. The wordmark sits left in #26251e. Five centered links (Models, Product, Enterprise, Pricing, Resources) are CursorGothic 14px weight 400 with 6px 16px padding and a 0px radius. The right side holds a text "Sign in" link with 4px padding followed by the two compact pills. Because it shares the canvas color, the bar disappears into the page instead of announcing itself.

### Feature Panel (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Text column beside product mockup

The workhorse section block. Its spec is background #f2f1ed, 4px radius, no border and no shadow, with 12px inset around a mockup stage and 22px text inset. The heading is CursorGothic 22px weight 400 in #26251e, followed immediately by a description at the same 22px in #0000008c and then a 16px #f54e00 link. Panels alternate between text-left and text-right. Heading and description share one size, so color alone does the ranking — the clearest expression of the quiet-type thesis.

### Hero Painting Stage

**Role:** Backdrop for floating app windows

A framed oil-painting stage. It spans the full 1300px container at 1300×780 with a 4px radius, and an impressionist lake-and-mountain painting fills the frame edge to edge. Two overlapping app windows sit on top: Cursor Desktop on the left and Cursor CLI breaking past the right and bottom edges. It carries no border, and the shadow lives on the windows, not the frame. Its painted palette is decorative, not a system token. It turns a screenshot into a gallery piece and is the system's licensed outlier for color.

### App Window Mockup

**Role:** Live HTML product reproduction

Floating software, not a screenshot. The window uses background #f7f7f4, a 10px radius and a 30px title bar holding three 8px #e1e0db traffic-light dots plus a centered system-ui 12px title in #0000008c. Shadow is lg (28px/70px plus a 1px #26251e1a ring) for desktop windows and xl for the CLI. The sidebar text is system-ui 12px and 13px. Inner tiles use 10px radius and code blocks 4px. These are the only shadowed objects on the page, so depth itself means "this is the product".

### Agent Sidebar List — Selected Row

**Role:** Task queue inside the mockup

A dense native list. Group labels are system-ui 11px weight 500, uppercase, 0.05px tracking, in #00000061. Rows use 10px 12px 10px 14px padding, system-ui 12px weight 400 titles in #26251e and #00000061 timestamps. The selected row is filled #ebeae5 with a 0px radius, and diff counts use #1f8a65 and the mockup-internal red #cf2d56. A tonal fill instead of a highlight color keeps the mockup inside the paper palette.

### Agent Composer Input

**Role:** Prompt box with mode chip

The quietest input on the web. Its spec is background #f7f7f4, 1px #26251e1a border, 8px radius and 8px 8px 6px padding. The placeholder "Plan, search, build anything…" is system-ui 13px in #00000061. A plan chip below uses background #c0853226, text #c08532 and a 9999px radius, and a 20px #e1e0db circular send button sits right. It has no focus glow. The amber chip is a sanctioned outlier — mode color that belongs to the app, not to the marketing chrome.

### Install Command Field

**Role:** Copyable curl one-liner

A terminal fragment. Its spec is background #ebeae5, 4px radius and 8px 6px padding, with berkeleyMono 12px weight 400 in #26251e truncated by a fade. A 22px ink circle (#26251e fill, 9999px radius) with a copy glyph in #f7f7f4 sits at the right edge, and there is no shadow. It treats the CLI install as a first-class CTA, which is unusual and intentional for a developer audience.

### Logo Tile Row

**Role:** Customer proof under hero

A shelf of equal paper tiles. Each tile is background #f2f1ed with a 4px radius, no border and roughly a 3:2 ratio, with 8px gutters across the 1300px container. Stripe, Datadog, Linear, NVIDIA and Figma wordmarks are rendered monochrome in #26251e. The label above is CursorGothic 14px weight 400 with 0.14px tracking, centered. Tiling the logos instead of floating them on the canvas turns social proof into an inventory grid.

### Ember Text Link

**Role:** Per-feature "learn more"

The only chrome color. It is CursorGothic 16px weight 400 in #f54e00 with no underline, a trailing → arrow, no background and no padding. It appears once per feature panel, below the 22px description. Orange on paper is punctuation rather than decoration, and its rarity (10 uses on a 14-section page) is what makes it legible as a path forward.

### Footer

**Role:** Sitemap columns and legal

A closing paper slab. It is full-bleed 1920px with background #f2f1ed, 67px 20px 30px padding and 526px height. Link columns are CursorGothic 14px weight 400 in #26251e, with no border-top and no shadow. The footer is simply the Linen Panel surface extended to the viewport edges, so the page ends by changing tone rather than by drawing a line.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Cap the hero headline at 26px CursorGothic weight 400 with -0.325px tracking — the product window below is the real headline.
- Rank feature heading and description by color, both at 22px: #26251e for the claim, #0000008c for the support — size stays constant so the eye reads one sentence in two tones.
- Build depth in the chrome by tonal steps only: #f7f7f4 → #f2f1ed → #ebeae5 → #e6e5e0 — each step marks a layer without a shadow.
- Reserve shadows for floating app windows, using the lg value (0px 28px 70px #00000024 plus a 1px #26251e1a ring) — depth is the signal that something is software.
- Use 9999px pills for every action and 4px corners for every panel, tile and image — two shapes, no middle ground in the chrome.
- Set code, paths and terminal output in berkeleyMono 12px at 1.625 line-height — the generous leading makes transcripts readable at small size.
- Spend #f54e00 only on one text link per feature panel at 16px — the accent stays a waypoint, not a theme.

### Don't

- Don't scale the hero to a conventional 64px bold display — it breaks the thesis that the interface, not the type, carries the page.
- Don't introduce weight 600 or 700 in CursorGothic; marketing type stays at 400 with 500 used twice — bold belongs to system-ui inside the mockups, and borrowing it blurs the line between page and product.
- Don't fill a primary button with #f54e00 — the ember accent loses its rarity the moment it becomes a 42px slab.
- Don't swap the paper stack for pure #ffffff and neutral greys — it kills the warm #f7f7f4/#26251e harmony that every hairline (#26251e1a) depends on.
- Don't add drop shadows to feature panels or logo tiles at #f2f1ed — shadowing the chrome flattens the contrast that makes the floating windows read as live software.
- Don't round panels to 12–16px like a typical SaaS card — the 4px corner is what makes the panels read as paper sheets rather than app widgets.
- Never let amber #c08532 or green #34785c escape the mockups into nav, buttons or headings — status colors outside the product read as decoration and break the one-accent budget.

## Elevation

- **Desktop app windows in hero and feature stages:** `0px 28px 70px 0px #00000024, 0px 14px 32px 0px #0000001a, 0px 0px 0px 1px #26251e1a`
- **Cursor CLI window overlapping the hero edge:** `0px 22px 70px 4px #0000004d, 0px 0px 0px 0.5px #00000026`
- **Secondary floating window (cursor-agent over Slack):** `0px 25px 50px -12px #00000040, 0px 12px 24px -8px #00000026, 0px 0px 0px 0.5px #26251e1a`
- **Inline popovers and image thumbnails in mockups:** `0px 0px 0px 1px #26251e1a, 0px 18px 36px -18px #00000047`
- **Dropdown menus inside mockups:** `0px 10px 15px -3px #0000001a, 0px 4px 6px -4px #0000001a`
- **Avatar stack separation:** `0px 0px 0px 2px #fcfcfc` (the ring color is mockup-internal, not a system token)

The page chrome itself is flat. Panels, tiles, nav and footer rely on tonal layering. Every shadow above belongs to an object that represents running software.

## Imagery

The page uses no photography and no conventional illustration. Its imagery is product reproduction staged on painting. Three painted landscapes serve as gallery backdrops: an impressionist lake under misty mountains, a pale grey wash and a sage meadow. Each fills a 4px-radius frame with no border. On top float live HTML mockups of Cursor Desktop, the CLI, a browser agent and Slack, each with a 10px radius and heavy window shadows. Inline thumbnails inside the mockups reuse the paintings. Icons come from the CursorIcons16 glyph font at 14px, drawn as single-weight line icons in #26251e. Avatars are 9999px circles with a 2px ring. There are no gradients, glows or orbs, and the painterly hues are decorative, not system tokens. The narrative is that code-writing software belongs in a quiet studio, framed like art and handled like a tool.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1300px container centered on a 1920px canvas, under a fixed 52px nav: wordmark left, five links centered, Sign in plus two pills right, all on #f7f7f4. The hero is left-aligned: a two-line 26px headline, two 42px pills with an 8px gap, and then the 1300×780 painting stage carrying overlapping windows. A one-row logo shelf of #f2f1ed tiles follows. Feature panels (#f2f1ed, 4px) alternate text-left/mockup-right and mockup-left/text-right in roughly a 1:2 column split, separated by 90px gaps. The footer is a full-bleed #f2f1ed slab with link columns and 67px top padding. At 375px, drop the display size to 22px and the section gap to 48px, and stack text above mockup with a 16px element gap. Overall density is compact.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f7f7f4 (Paper Canvas)
- section panel: #f2f1ed (Linen Panel)
- primary text: #26251e (Ink)
- secondary text: #0000008c (Graphite Caption)
- hairline: #26251e1a (Smoke Hairline)
- accent link: #f54e00 (Ember Link)
- primary action: #26251e (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars render in Ink #26251e and the paper neutrals. Only diff-style data may use Moss Diff #1f8a65 as solid text or as a 15% tint, and Ember Link #f54e00 is not used as a data fill.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #26251e, text color #f7f7f4, a 1px solid #26251e border, border-radius 9999px, padding 12px 22px, and a total height of 42px. Use CursorGothic (fallback Geist at 400) 16px weight 400 with line-height 1.0 and no letter-spacing, followed by a ⤓ glyph separated by a 6px gap. No box-shadow. On hover, shift the background to #26251e at 90% via opacity 0.9 only. Pair it 8px to the right with a secondary pill identical in size, using background #e6e5e0 and text #26251e with a trailing →.

2. Build a hero section on a #f7f7f4 page inside a 1300px centered container. Start with a left-aligned h1 in CursorGothic 26px weight 400, line-height 1.25, letter-spacing -0.325px, color #26251e, broken over two lines and capped at 580px wide. Place two 42px pills 22px below it: primary ink and secondary pebble as described above. Leave 48px of space, then add a 1300×780 stage with border-radius 4px whose background is a painted landscape image set to object-fit cover. Over it, float a desktop window (background #f7f7f4, radius 10px, shadow `0px 28px 70px 0px #00000024, 0px 14px 32px 0px #0000001a, 0px 0px 0px 1px #26251e1a`, 30px title bar with three 8px #e1e0db dots). Add a second CLI window offset right that overflows the stage bottom, using shadow `0px 22px 70px 4px #0000004d, 0px 0px 0px 0.5px #00000026` and berkeleyMono 12px text at line-height 1.625.

3. Build a feature panel: a 1300px block with background #f2f1ed, border-radius 4px, no border or shadow, laid out as two columns at 1:2. The text column has 22px inset and is vertically centered. It holds a heading in CursorGothic 22px weight 400, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing -0.11px, color #26251e, then immediately a description at the same 22px and line-height in #0000008c, then 16px of space and a link in CursorGothic 16px weight 400 color #f54e00 ending with →. The mockup column holds a 4px-radius painted stage with 12px inset from the panel edge and a floating app window inside it with radius 10px. Alternate the column order on the next panel and separate panels by 90px.

4. Build a navigation bar: position fixed, top 0, height 52px, full width, background #f7f7f4, no border or shadow, with content in a 1300px container. Place the Cursor wordmark left in #26251e at 96px wide. Center five links (Models, Product, Enterprise, Pricing, Resources) in CursorGothic 14px weight 400, line-height 1.5, color #26251e, padding 6px 16px, radius 0px. On the right, add a "Sign in" text link with 4px padding, then an outlined pill (transparent fill, 1px #26251e1a border, text #26251e) and an ink pill (#26251e fill, #f7f7f4 text). Both pills are 14px weight 400, padding 6px 10px, radius 9999px, 28px tall, with an 8px gap between them.

## Quiet Type Discipline

The discipline is that type never competes with the product. CursorGothic stays at weight 400 from 14px to 26px, and the largest marketing text on a 1920px page is 26px. This is a deliberate refusal of the 64–96px hero convention. Hierarchy is carried by Ink #26251e versus Graphite Caption #0000008c at identical sizes, and by the sheer scale contrast against a 780px-tall mockup stage. It breaks the moment someone adds a 48px headline, a 600-weight section title or a gradient wordmark. To extend the system, add new levels as color tiers or spacing, not as size. A new page title can reach 26px with tighter tracking. A new emphasis can drop to #00000061 for de-emphasis. A larger moment should be solved by a larger mockup rather than larger letters.

## Mockup-Owned Color

The chromatic budget is one hue in the chrome, Ember #f54e00, while the product mockups carry their own status palette. That palette is amber #c08532, green #34785c and #1f8a65, mockup-internal red #cf2d56, and mockup-internal blues #65afe0 and #278dcc. The rule is jurisdictional: color is allowed when it represents app state, not when it decorates the page. It breaks when a designer lifts the amber "Continue" fill into a marketing CTA, tints a feature panel green, or sets section eyebrows in orange. To extend it, new product mockups may bring any status color they genuinely need. New marketing elements get ink, the paper neutrals, and at most one #f54e00 text link. If a page needs more energy, use the painted backdrop, which is decorative and not tokenized.

## Paper Tonal Ladder

Elevation in the chrome is a four-rung ladder of warm greys: #f7f7f4, #f2f1ed, #ebeae5 and #e6e5e0. Each rung is roughly a 2% luminance step, all sharing the same yellow undertone as Ink #26251e. Panels sit on canvas, selected rows sit on panels, and secondary buttons sit one rung lower. No chrome shadow is needed because the eye reads the warm tone shift as stacked paper. The ladder breaks if a cool grey such as a neutral slate enters it, if pure white appears as a card fill, or if a hairline uses neutral black instead of #26251e1a. To extend it, insert a new surface only between existing rungs and keep the hue. Never add a fifth rung darker than #e1e0db, which is reserved for knob-sized details.

## Similar Brands

- **Cursor** — shares Anthropic's warm off-white canvas with olive-black ink and a single orange-family accent, but swaps Anthropic's serif headlines for a weight-400 gothic held at 26px.
- **Cursor** — shares Zed's strategy of letting a live editor reproduction serve as the hero, but sets it on painted landscapes rather than dark code-on-black.
- **Cursor** — shares Notion's warm-paper neutral ladder and minimal shadow use in page chrome, but replaces Notion's illustrated characters with HTML product mockups.
- **Cursor** — shares Vercel's pairing of a proprietary grotesk with a mono for technical text, but inverts Vercel's high-contrast black-and-white into low-contrast paper tones.
- **Cursor** — shares The Browser Company's habit of framing software on painterly backdrops, but with a far stricter one-accent budget and 4px rectangular panels.
